title: Definition editing
description: Prepares supported changes to definitions and relationships while preserving entity identity and containment meaning.
responsibilities: Prepare same-entity revisions and explain unsupported identity or parentage changes.
Author relationship facts once and preserve their intended endpoints when preparing a resulting model state.
Submit an explicit revision candidate for checked retention and report its actual outcome.
Prepare state-bound relationship candidates and derive both endpoint views from confirmed resulting facts without storing inverses.
owned_state: Proposed definition and relationship edits while an authoring operation is being prepared; retained content belongs to Definition storage.

includes: Supported same-entity edits and typed relationship authoring.
excludes: Independent copies of stored definitions, authoritative inverse relationship lists, semantic reparenting disguised as a rename, or change approval.

design_limits: FUNC-008 relationship editing is specified in README.md and IF-001/IF-002. The logical contract does not define a callable public command.

README.md defines participant-facing logical admission and outcome presentation. Callable command and runtime presentation adapters remain undesigned; adoption into an engineering baseline remains subject to separately governed change authority.

The owning README refines IR001 current-knowledge Design and existing AR001–009 contributions. Logical model services and participant-assisted documentary association do not establish installed commands or executed satisfaction.

sources.basis: Analyst-proposed responsibility boundary derived from the existing Function landscape. Assigned Functions remain authoritative for behavior; this record describes target architecture, not observed implementation.
Derive single-fact relationship editing, candidate admission and retention boundaries from SR-008. Proposed Design only; no runtime implementation or satisfaction claim.

Refine existing definition custody, identity-preserving evolution and current-context/rationale presentation through IF-001/002. Preserve requirements and allocations; proposed Design only, without runtime implementation or satisfaction.
